# MDL003: mdl-include-cycle

The include graph has a cycle.

The offending include is skipped so the rest of the model still loads. A diamond is not a cycle.

## Examples

### MDL003 include cycle / Two files including each other fire #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
include "a.grmb";
=== design/a.grmb
grimble = "2";
part of m;
include "b.grmb";
=== design/b.grmb
grimble = "2";
part of m;
include "a.grmb";
```
